objective: Attempt to falsify the repairs for GB06-R01 and GB06-R02, then issue a new pass/fail verdict without granting any broader Gate B claim.
affected_files_and_interfaces: tools/gate_b_slice.mjs: source policy, runtime integrity audit and evidence publisher
invariants: The live RAF is stopped and the full fixed-step updater chain runs.
The driver does not retain or invoke a placement/teleport helper, write actor position, write HP/lung/progression state, call direct damage/kill, or manufacture a kill event.
All three authored courtyard actors begin at full health and every HP/death transition has normal player-combat telemetry inside a fixed step.
The current-attempt evidence is atomically invalidated before browser work and every failed attempt leaves passed=false.
Evidence is bound to state revision and hashes of engine, driver, runner and built bundle.
The claim remains a Chapter 1 partial slice only.
assumptions: The review is source-aware, not source-blind.
SwiftShader mobile emulation is not real-device evidence.
constraints: Use a disposable copy for destructive/adversarial mutations and generated evidence where practical.
Do not use README.md or implementer prose as evidence.
Do not approve B1, B2, C1, D3, play feel, performance, full playtime or a complete Gate B pass.
prohibited_changes: Remote push, merge, deployment or publication
acceptance_criteria: A clean two-context run exits zero with identical semantic outcomes and no browser/runtime integrity errors.
The built-in source fixtures reject aliases, brackets, position/HP/lung/progression writes, aliased damage/kill and manufactured kill events.
The placement-alias runtime probe exits nonzero and leaves authoritative evidence passed=false.
The precombat-HP runtime probe exits nonzero and leaves authoritative evidence passed=false.
A forced two-context failure exits nonzero and leaves current, revision/hash-bound authoritative evidence passed=false.
A final clean rerun restores only a new current passed=true report.
The exact original retained-helper and direct-HP review reproductions cannot make the official runner pass.
tests_required: A final clean rerun plus structured evidence inspection
known_results_to_distrust_and_reproduce: Integration-owner forced-failure run exited 1 while both gameplay repetitions otherwise completed; durable evidence was passed=false.
Integration-owner placement-alias and precombat-HP probes each exited 1 and left durable evidence passed=false.
Integration-owner clean run completed two fresh contexts at 302.6m, 857ppm/0.229, 10 normal hits and 3 proven kills with no integrity violation.
known_risks: Text scanning is defense in depth and cannot prove semantics by itself; runtime invariants are mandatory.
Full-precision environmental and HP measurements may drift while the selected semantic outcome remains repeatable.
Dialogue automation uses production callbacks but is not a source-blind usability result.
rollback_instructions: Restore the verified baseline 222fafa5dc169200dd06848f65ec1921a0a16f53 in a disposable workspace; do not destructively reset the shared worktree.
